Future<int> plain() async {
  report();
  return 1;
}

Future<int> awaited() async {
  await warmUp();
  return 1;
}

Future<int> awaitedDecl() async {
  final limit = await loadLimit();
  return 1;
}

Future<int> awaitedLoop() async {
  for (final item in items) {
    await validate(item);
  }
  return 1;
}
